title.en: The first peoples of this land
title.fr: Les premiers peuples de ce territoire

text.en: First Nations cultures are many and full of life. Religious belief lies at their root: how people stand with the Creator, with the natural world, and with one another.
text.fr: Les cultures des Premières Nations sont nombreuses et bien vivantes. La croyance religieuse en est la racine : le rapport des personnes avec le Créateur, avec la nature et les unes avec les autres.

source.quote: Diverse, vibrant First Nations cultures were rooted in religious beliefs about their relationship to the Creator, the natural environment and each other.

text.en: Aboriginal children were placed in residential schools by the federal government. The aim was to teach them and to make them part of the country's mainstream culture.
text.fr: Le gouvernement fédéral a placé des enfants autochtones dans des pensionnats. Le but était de les instruire et de les assimiler à la culture dominante du pays.

source.quote: the federal government placed many Aboriginal children in residential schools to educate and assimilate them into mainstream Canadian culture

text.en: The residential schools had too little money, and they were hard on the students.
text.fr: Les pensionnats manquaient d'argent et la vie y était dure pour les élèves.

source.quote: The schools were poorly funded and inflicted hardship on the students

text.en: Some of the students in the residential schools suffered physical abuse.
text.fr: Certains élèves des pensionnats ont subi de la violence physique.

source.quote: The schools were poorly funded and inflicted hardship on the students; some were physically abused.

text.en: Aboriginal peoples in Canada today feel a new pride and a new confidence.
text.fr: Aujourd'hui, au Canada, les peuples autochtones éprouvent une fierté et une confiance renouvelées.

source.quote: In today’s Canada, Aboriginal peoples enjoy renewed pride and confidence
